name: Motion Design Skill
summary: Agent skill teaching motion design for UI: timing, easing, choreography and Disney's 12 principles adapted for interfaces.
description: A SKILL.md package that teaches AI agents to think like motion directors before writing animation code: an 8-step checklist, duration and easing tables, motion personality archetypes, and quality rules. Supporting docs cover the philosophy (Disney's 12 principles adapted for UI, emotion-to-motion mapping), ready-to-use patterns (entrance/exit, state feedback, ambient motion, choreography) and reference lookup tables. Implementation-agnostic — CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, Lottie or Spring — and installs into 40+ agents including Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot.
